results.title: The Matrix
results.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

results.title: The Matrix Resurrections
results.overview: Plagued by strange memories, Neo's life takes an unexpected turn when he finds himself back inside the Matrix.

results.name: Threat Matrix
results.overview: Against the rising threat, the Homeland Security Agency has created a highly specialized, elite task force trained and equipped to counter anyone or anything that threatens our nation. The head of this super-secret team is Special Agent John Kilmer. He reports only to the President and has authority to call upon the technical skills, firepower and the specialist agents of the FBI, CIA and NSA.

results.title: The Matrix Reloaded
results.overview: The Resistance builds in numbers as humans are freed from the Matrix and brought to the city of Zion. Neo discovers his superpowers, including the ability to see the code inside the Matrix. With machine sentinels digging to Zion in 72 hours, Neo, Morpheus and Trinity must find the Keymaker to ultimately reach the Source.

results.title: The Matrix Revolutions
results.overview: The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of the machines as Neo fights to end the war at another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

results.name: Matrix
results.overview: A murdered hitman is given a second chance at redemption by returning to Earth as a reluctant guardian, tasked with protecting people in danger while struggling against the darkness of his former life.

results.title: The Matrix: Generation
results.overview: After the 1999 premiere of the first Matrix movie, it became a pop culture phenomenon. A special documentary about the Matrix saga and its prophetic aspects.

results.title: Armitage III: Poly Matrix
results.original_title: アミテージ・ザ・サード POLY-MATRIX
results.overview: Ross Sylibus is assigned to a police unit on a Martian colony, to find that women are being murdered by a psychotic named D'anclaude. He is assigned a very unorthodox partner named Naomi Armitage, who seems to have links to the victims. To stir things up more, every victim is found to be an illegally made third-generation android.

results.name: Matrix Dreads
results.overview: Matrix Dreads is a strange universe that suddenly appears in the middle of the city of Arlilowy and targets Zax, Hans, Ruzy and Suzy to be brought into the universe.

known_for.name: Canada's Drag Race
known_for.overview: Drag queens showcase their Canadian charisma, uniqueness, nerve, and talent to become Canada's Next Drag Superstar and to win the $100,000 grand prize.

known_for.name: Tongue Thai'd with Pangina Heals
known_for.overview: Pangina Heals, star of Drag Race Thailand and RuPaul’s Drag Race UK vs the World takes us on a food tour of Thai Town in Hollywood, CA. She challenges her guests to amp up the spice, from one dish to the next, as they spill secrets over a meal of Thai delicacies. Don’t get burned! Sweat it out with Pangina Heals.

known_for.name: Bring Back My Girls
known_for.overview: Host Ts Madison brings back the casts of your favorite RuPaul’s Drag Race seasons in front of a live audience at DragCon LA. Queens from the US, UK, Canada, Holland and Down Under reunite to spill the tea on their seasons and update fans on where they are now! The queens face-off with their fans in a live Q&A, and Ts Madison asks all the questions - even the ones that fans are afraid to ask. There are laughs, fights, nostalgia, insider stories, tears, and even some never before heard confessions.

results.title: Sexual Matrix
results.overview: A professor designing a machine designed to meet the naughtiest fantasies. In order to perfect the discovery, he performed tests on various subjects, aided by his very appealing assistant.

known_for.title: Collide
known_for.overview: A gripping chronicle of three couples over the course of one fateful night in an LA restaurant named Collide. Hunter finds himself on an awkward blind date with the captivating Tamira, while a busboy and his waitress girlfriend hope to score a big payday, and outside, Peter sits in his car observing his wife Angie meet with the restaurant’s manager. Though all strangers, their stories are weaved together as they hurl towards an explosive end.

results.title: The Matrix Revisited
results.overview: The film goes behind the scenes of the 1999 sci-fi movie The Matrix.

results.title: Dinosaur Matrix
results.overview: A method by which drawings can be enlarged on a grid.

results.title: Armitage: Dual Matrix
results.original_title: アミテージ・ザ・サード DUAL-MATRIX
results.overview: Naomi Armitage and Ross Sylibus have changed their names and live with their daughter Yoko as a happy and normal family on Mars — until an android riot breaks out at an anti-matter plant on Earth.

results.name: Matrix
results.overview: Matrix was an Italian news program and talks show television, broadcast on Canale 5, from 2005 and 2012, and rerun on Mediaset Plus: it was a rival program of RAI flagship news program Porta a Porta.

results.title: Matrix Dream Maze
results.overview: Legend has it that people who meet the dream demon are trapped there forever.

results.title: Matrix
results.overview: A piece of abstract cinema by John Whitney. A series squares follow a 3-dimensional track, each one with a slight delay after the other.

results.title: Buhera mátrix
results.overview: Geri’s life flashes before him in the “Buhera Matrix,” a cringe-worthy slideshow of childhood photos from Pioneer camp to prom night. He relives the absurd clash between Mickey Mouse and socialist youth rituals, debates the perfect horse-chestnut hole size and survives the notorious fruit-game initiation. As the disastrous graduation and its Bavarian-style sacrifices cap off his painfully vivid memories, the film spins forward through Hungary’s late-20th-and-early-21st-century history through the eyes of a ’70s-born generation.

results.title: Matrix
results.overview: Abstract art film made for gallery exhibition.
